title: Fixing a Wobbly Table

characters.goal: Point out the problem and suggest a quick fix.

characters.role: A roommate who checks the table legs for loose screws.
characters.goal: Examine the legs, use a tool or pad, and fix the wobble.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Whoa! Be careful putting your glass down on this table.

dialogue.text: Oh! Did it wobble again? It's been doing that all week.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Look underneath the table and explain what seems to be causing the wobble.

dialogue.text: Is the leg just loose, or is the floor uneven?

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Looks like one of the screws underneath needs to be tightened.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Offer to get the toolbox or a felt pad from the drawer.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Tighten the screw or place the pad, then test the table stability.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Hey, it doesn't shake at all now! Nice job!

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Problem solved in less than five minutes!

dialogue.text: Offer to make tea or coffee now that the table is stable.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: That sounds great, thanks!

dialogue.text: Ask if breakfast is included in the night rate.

dialogue.text: Explain the breakfast service hours and inclusions.

title: Borrowing Gardening Tools
situation: A neighbor wants to clean up their front yard and knocks on their neighbor's door to ask to borrow a rake.

characters.role: A neighbor starting yard work.
characters.goal: Ask to borrow a garden rake and offer to return it later today.

characters.role: A neighbor with a shed full of garden tools.
characters.goal: Lend the tool willingly and offer extra advice or garden bags.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Hi! Sorry to disturb you on a Saturday morning.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Oh, no worries at all! How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Explain that you are cleaning up dry leaves in your yard and ask to borrow a rake.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Agree gladly and mention where the rake is stored in your shed.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: That is so kind of you! I'll bring it back before evening.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Take your time! No rush to return it today.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Ask if they have any extra yard waste bags you could have or buy.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Offer a couple of spare paper yard bags for free.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: You are a lifesaver! I really appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Neighborly support is what we're here for! Good luck with the yard work!

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Thank them again and head back to your yard.
